reason: Stream Y: project-knowledge relevance. New knowledge_rerank.py (pinned local cross-encoder mxbai-rerank-xsmall-v1: HTTPS download by commit with size+SHA-256 verification, background preparation, onnxruntime scoring, calibrated relevance gate with a paraphrase rescue route and a no-subject pre-gate); ChatService._retrieve gates the top candidates through it (fallback: unchanged ranking), prepare_async skips planning for subject-less messages and runs retrieval in a worker thread; ChromaKnowledgeIndex carries the reranker, reports it in index status, starts it after indexing, and records which query matched each chunk; the CLI wires it with NEBULA_V3_KNOWLEDGE_MODELS_DIR / NEBULA_V3_KNOWLEDGE_RERANKER. Selected: the new reranker tests (gate boundaries, variant retry, download/verification/HTTPS/retry, chat and harness integration, fallback), the knowledge index and ingestion tests (status contract updated), chat and reference-material tests (retrieval paths and the no-subject gate), conversation.search tests (share ChromaKnowledgeIndex.embed), turn preflight latency and chat queue (knowledge retrieval during preparation), and the harness knowledge tests (harness_knowledge_search/context). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible layout change (the index-status response gains an optional reranker object the UI ignores). The real-model calibration test (test_the_pinned_model_meets_its_calibration) is skipped unless NEBULA_TEST_RERANKER_DIR holds the pinned files, so CI never downloads the model; it was run locally (lexical 14/14, paraphrase 12/15, unrelated 13/13, hard negatives 4/8). Operator help retrieval, missions and conversation.search ranking are unchanged. Real-Core evidence is in the PR body. No full suite.
